reference_sql:
SELECT a.product_id, b.valid_from,
       CASE WHEN b.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_to > a.valid_to THEN a.valid_to ELSE b.valid_to END - b.valid_from + 1 AS shared_days
FROM price_history a
JOIN price_history b
  ON b.product_id = a.product_id
 AND b.valid_from > a.valid_from
 AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_from <= a.valid_to)
alternatives:
WITH pairs AS (  -- one row per pair of overlapping windows
  SELECT a.product_id, b.valid_from,
         CASE WHEN b.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_to > a.valid_to THEN a.valid_to ELSE b.valid_to END AS shared_end
  FROM price_history a
  JOIN price_history b
    ON b.product_id = a.product_id
   AND b.valid_from > a.valid_from
   AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_from <= a.valid_to)
)
SELECT product_id, valid_from, date_diff('day', valid_from, shared_end) + 1 AS shared_days
FROM pairs

SELECT a.product_id, b.valid_from, LEAST(a.valid_to, COALESCE(b.valid_to, a.valid_to)) - b.valid_from + 1 AS shared_days FROM price_history a JOIN price_history b ON b.product_id = a.product_id AND b.valid_from > a.valid_from AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_from <= a.valid_to)

         CASE WHEN b.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_to > a.valid_to THEN a.valid_to ELSE b.valid_to END AS shared_end
  FROM price_history a
  JOIN price_history b
    ON b.product_id = a.product_id
   AND b.valid_from > a.valid_from

)
SELECT product_id, valid_from, date_diff('day', valid_from, shared_end) + 1 AS shared_days
FROM pairs
other_way.tradeoff: A named step finds the shared end first, which makes the day count easy to check, but one expression does it in a single query.

solver.query:
SELECT b.product_id,
       b.valid_from,
       CASE WHEN a.valid_to IS NULL AND b.valid_to IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE date_diff('day', CAST(b.valid_from AS DATE), CAST(least(a.valid_to, b.valid_to) AS DATE)) + 1 END AS shared_days
FROM price_history a
JOIN price_history b
  ON a.product_id = b.product_id
 AND b.valid_from > a.valid_from
 AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_from <= a.valid_to)
